Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the "Updated Understanding" section. After WebSurfer correctly identified that Chiang Hsiao-chang is the daughter of **Chiang Ching-kuo** (not Chiang Kai-shek), the Planner incorrectly stated, "Chian Hsiao-chang's father is Chiang Kai-shek." This is a factual error; Chiang Ching-kuo was the son of Chiang Kai-shek. Consequently, the Planner proceeded to search for the children of Chiang Kai-shek (finding Chiang Ching-kuo and Chiang Wei-kuo) instead of the children of Chiang Ching-kuo (finding Hsiao-wu, as requested by the prompt). This confusion between the grandfather and the father led directly to the wrong answer.
